content:
It's time to take a look at the latest iPhone 18 Pro cases. Apple's newest products officially opened for pre-order this morning, and major brands are ready. Apple has launched a series of colorful silicone cases, brand-new TechWoven fabric cases, and a variety of classic designs from top third-party manufacturers. From a new burgundy version with a built-in stand, to ultra-personalized models with great feel, to premium leather styles from brands like Nomad and Burton Goods — there's something for everyone. Brands like Spigen also offer affordable options starting at $14.

Best iPhone 18 Pro Cases

Featured Pick: ESR

ESR's brand-new lineup of iPhone 18 Pro cases and accessories has officially arrived, offering premium color options and patented technology. The standout is the new Atelier Vegan Leather MagSafe Case, featuring a built-in zinc-alloy Flex stand that seamlessly merges with the camera bump for enhanced protection, reportedly providing 3x military-grade protection while being "soft, flexible, and comfortable to the touch." The new Atelier collection comes in four colorways, with additional accessories to match the new burgundy, glacial, black, and silver iPhone 18 Pro models.

  • ESR Atelier Vegan Leather MagSafe Case with Flex Stand: $42 (originally $46) | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR UltraFit Armorite Pro Screen Protector: $30 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Cyber FlickLock MagSafe Case: $21 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Geo MagSafe Card Wallet Stand with Anti-Slip Grip: $46 (originally $50) | Amazon or ESR

Nomad

Nomad, the renowned premium leather case brand, has a full lineup of cases ready for all iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max flagship models. The brand has also introduced a new Rugged Case series this year, with each colorway featuring contour textures inspired by the Baja California Peninsula:

  • Rugged Case: $70
  • Colors: Norte, Balandra, Arroyo
  • Clear Leather Case: $69
  • Colors: Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black
  • Magnetic Leather Back: $59
  • Colors: Burgundy, Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black, Olde Dublin
  • Sport Case: $55
  • Colors: Black, Driftwood, Rosewood, Lunar Grey
  • Modern Leather Case: $69 to $89
  • Traditional Leather Case: $79 to $99
  • Rugged Leather Case: $79
  • Color: Rustic Brown

Featured Pick: Dbrand

Dbrand's hugely popular Grip Case is ready to support the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max. In addition to having one of the cleanest designs and an ultra-grippy feel, it continues to fully support custom skins this year, allowing you to add a personal touch; pairing it with a matching Prism screen protector when buying together also gets you a discount.

  • Dbrand Grip Case (iPhone 18 Pro/Max): $55. Customizable, drop-proof, ultra-grippy, with excellent button feel.
  • Dbrand Prism 2.0 (iPhone 18 Pro/Max), 2-pack: $35 (save $5 when purchased with a case). Easy installation, auto-alignment, completely dust-free.

Dbrand has also launched a new MNML case series this year, starting at $39, focused on minimalist and stylish designs at affordable prices, retaining MagSafe support while maintaining the brand's signature crisp button feel.

  • Dbrand MNML iPhone 18 Pro/Max Case: $39. Colors: Black, Marine, Tan, Burgundy.

MUJJO Troubadour

  • Full Leather Case (iPhone 18 Series): $59

  • The detachable magnetic back panel lets you switch between two modes. With the back panel attached: it's a slim, full-grain leather, MagSafe-compatible case.

Burton Goods

***Note: Enter our exclusive promo code 9TO520 at checkout for an additional 20% off the already reduced launch price (applies to the cases below). If the code doesn't work, try DUO10.

  • Luxury Pocket Book Folio (iPhone 18 Pro/Max): $89 (originally $119)
  • Heritage Leather Case (iPhone 18 Duo): $60 (originally $80)

UAG

UAG also offers a lineup of cases for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, featuring their signature reinforced corners, anti-slip edges, and rugged models with various drop-protection designs. If you want a case that can withstand harsh environments while still being suitable for daily protection, the UAG lineup is definitely worth considering.

  • UAG Mouve (iPhone Duo): $65
  • EGO TACTICAL UAG Urban Armor Gear Pathfinder Case (iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max): $80
  • UAG Civilian Grip Case: from $60
  • More…

YETI iPhone 18 Pro/18 Pro Max Case

If you want a rugged case for your new phone but don't like common brands like OtterBox or UAG, YETI's LoadOut series is definitely worth considering. These cases have passed the MIL-STD-810H drop test, provide reliable protection, support MagSafe, and come with a built-in rotating kickstand for hands-free use.

Mous

If you want a premium iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max case that won't make your phone too bulky, Mous is a strong choice. Mous now offers ultra-thin aramid fiber cases for the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max, as well as the following models.

  • Mous Limitless MagSafe Case: $75
  • Mous Clear Case: $70
  • Mous Limitless Aramid Fiber Case: $85
  • Mous Slim MagSafe Case: $55
  • Mous Slim Aramid Fiber Case: $70
  • More…

Aulumu

AULUMU's iPhone 18 Pro cases are known for their futuristic design, avant-garde style, and slim profile, standing out with unique textured finishes.

  • Aulumu A18 Ultra-Thin Aramid Fiber Case: $66
  • Aulumu A18 Pro Drop Protection Case (iPhone 18 Pro): $60
  • Aulumu A18 Frosted Case: $40

Pitaka

PITAKA cases are suitable for iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max users seeking an ultra-thin design. Their products are typically made from lightweight aramid fiber, with a clean and understated look, while maintaining MagSafe compatibility and providing additional protection around the camera and edges.

  • Pitaka Edge Aramid Fiber Texture Case: $60
  • Pitaka Summa Military-Grade Drop Protection Aramid Case: $80
  • Pitaka Cairn Rugged Protection Case: $60

OtterBox iPhone 18 Pro Series Cases

OtterBox also offers a diverse selection of cases for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, ranging from slim everyday models to heavy-duty rugged designs that provide reliable protection. Many of the new models support MagSafe, and some models add features like more grippy sides, accessory slots, raised camera protection, and built-in stands, allowing you to choose based on your preferred thickness and level of protection.

  • OtterBox Defender Series Pro: $70
  • OtterBox Commuter Series: $50
  • OtterBox Symmetry Series with Stand: $60
  • OtterBox Sole Series: $60
  • More…

Belkin

Belkin is another reliable option for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, especially suited for users who prefer a clean style, don't want to make their phone too bulky, but don't need a military-grade case. Their lineup typically includes MagSafe-compatible clear and protective cases with raised screen and camera edges, and some models (such as the Protect+) add reinforced corners, striking a good balance between everyday protection and slim design.

  • Belkin Clear MagSafe Case: $30
  • Belkin Qi2-Compatible MagSafe Case with Anti-Slip Grip: $50
  • Belkin Protect+ Case with Air Cushion Corners: $60
